description.short_caption: Colonoscopic image showing a worm-like structure in the colonic lumen.
description.detailed_description: This colonoscopic image reveals a worm-like structure, likely a parasitic organism, within the colonic lumen. The surrounding mucosa appears erythematous, suggesting possible inflammation or irritation. The organism is slender, white, and curved, consistent with a helminthic parasite. The image is well-focused, highlighting the parasite against the mucosal background.
visible_findings: worm-like structure in the colonic lumen
